reason: The README's core plugin runs as a local MCP stdio server that reads, renders and crops local files with no API key or GPU.
demo: README 'Install' manual Skill + MCP setup and 'Try it' (core plugin): run the qwen-mm-plugins-core MCP server (src/capabilities/core/qwen_mm_plugins_core) and use its tools on local files
goal: Get the `core` capability's MCP server (python3 src/capabilities/core/qwen_mm_plugins_core, or qwen-mm-plugins-core with the [viz] extra) running over stdio in native mode with no API key. It must answer tools/list and execute save_view (render page 1 of tests/assets/sample.pdf to PNG), crop, visualize (tests/assets/sample.csv) and read_image. Install the base deps plus the viz extras (pypdfium2, pandas, matplotlib etc.) into the python that /work/env.sh puts on PATH.
check: A JSON-RPC stdio client starts the core server, lists its tools, renders a PDF page to a PNG, crops it to the expected size, visualizes a CSV with expected text, and reads an image back.
